verdict.rationale: Postman offers CI/CD integration via CLI and Postman API (postman-docs-6, postman-docs-19), but there is no evidence of a native scheduler for recurring jobs/workflows within Postman itself — scheduling would require an external CI/CD cron trigger, which isn't documented as part of Postman's own capability set. missing for 10: no built-in job scheduler, no documented cron/interval trigger UI, no evidence of native recurring automation without external CI/CD tooling.
